Graphics quality

Lower settings reduce resolution, glow and shadows for smoother play on slower devices.

Text size
Motion

Turns off screen shake, camera drift and flashes, and slows effects.

Tutorial
Save backup

Progress and settings are saved in this browser only. Keep a backup code to restore it or move it to another device.

Something wrong?

Copies a short report (game version, browser, recent errors) to paste into a message to the developer. Nothing is sent automatically.

Privacy

No accounts, ads or tracking. The game sends nothing anywhere: your save and settings stay in this browser, and feedback and error reports are only copied when you press the button.

Kestrel
Station

You are 9, an independent contractor with an old rig and a Meridian contract. Cut rock, haul ore, build a fleet, and find out what the company is really building.
